# সহকারী অধ্যাপক ডাঃ জেবুন্নেসা জেবু (Dr. Jebunnesa Jebu)

> Assistant Professor, Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Infertility and IVF specialist, laparoscopic surgeon — Khulna Medical College Hospital, Khulna, Bangladesh.
> Credentials: MBBS (DMC), BCS (Health), DGO, MCPS, FCPS (Obs & Gynae), MRCOG (UK).
